_about: Nov 1, 2026 (Betsy OK'd): insurer networks kept OFF a scope's Price Finder pages. They stay read and stored (nothing deleted); the page build just leaves them out. A table is left out when its name contains one of the network codes. orchestrate_states.py applies it to the split step and, through ONLY_KEY, to every_code.py; each build's build_env.json records the exact tables used.

s7.why: Anthem pick list (claude/anthem-pick-list.md, approved Oct 18, 2026): on the pages, only Anthem's 3 most-used employer networks per state (Colorado 94% of employers, Georgia 93%, Missouri 91%). 17 of the other 20 Anthem catalog networks (25-1,491 employers each, about two thirds of the data) are left off. They were all switched on for the November seven-state build, the same setup behind the paused Oct 16 rebuild's ~20-day estimate. 051_06X0, 102_11R0 and 748_29S0 are NOT skipped: they are the same files as the Blue High Performance networks (HCSC rows in insurers/networks_s7.csv) already on the live pages.
s7.temporary: Betsy, Nov 1, 2026: eventually every network goes on the pages; this only keeps the November build fast so every state is up first. Add these 17 back as an update build (state_rebuild.json, mode update) after launch, then empty this list.
